decisions.oov_known_confound: romanized Hindi, slang and misspellings all count as OOV; oov_rate measures non-canonical-English density and correlates with hi_ratio; check VIF in Phase 4 and do not enter oov_rate and hi_ratio in the same regression untested
decisions.caps_ratio: fraction of alphabetic tokens with len >= 2 and token.isupper()
decisions.hi_ratio: count(HI) / max(1, count(HI) + count(EN))  [spec file as saved reads Hin/Eng; data tags are HI/EN]
decisions.empty_denominator_policy: features with an empty denominator are 0.0, never NaN
